provenance.description: Original synthesis informed by analysis of two public siren-test previews and manufacturer mechanical-siren documentation. No sampled recording appears in these outputs.
provenance.status: Original Town A is the preferred starting direction; C/D/E require listening review. No Unreal integration or real-warning signal conformity is claimed.

selection.Police: A persistent, B occasional traffic-linked variation; runtime implementation pending
selection.Fire: A persistent, separate B-like horn accent near traffic; runtime implementation pending
selection.Town: A preferred over B, refine toward traditional mechanical tornado-siren references

candidates.label: Original A · preferred starting direction
candidates.intent: Unchanged first-audition Town A, included as a level-matched comparison baseline.

candidates.label: C · classic single-tone motor siren
candidates.intent: Motor rises to a sustained 533 Hz tone, with rich chopper harmonics, gentle projected-horn swell and a long coast-down. Single-tone reference direction.

candidates.label: D · two-tone rotating warning
candidates.intent: Sustained 600/720 Hz tones after motor startup, richer harmonics and a stronger slow level swell. Informed by the recorded Thunderbolt test, with no sample playback.

candidates.label: E · deeper slow mechanical wail
candidates.intent: Keeps Town A's slow rise/fall character but adds motor inertia and richer 468/702 Hz harmonic families at the upper part of the cycle. Informed by the Streamwood recording's measured tone ratio.
